# fluxaos Installation Guide

Quick start guide for installing and setting up fluxaos.

---

## Quick Reference

**What are you trying to do?**

| Task | Command | Guide |
|------|---------|-------|
| **Install fluxaos** | `./flu install` | [Development Setup](development-setup.md) |
| **Add fluxaos to a project** | `flu project setup /path/to/project` | [Project Integration](project-integration.md) |
| **Fix project showing "fluxaos" branding** | `flu project setup /path/to/project -y` | [Migration Guide](migration-guide.md) |
| **Sync updates to all projects** | `fhc sync` | [Sync Workflows](../sync-workflows.md) |

---

## Installation Workflows

| Workflow | Use Case | Duration | Guide |
|----------|----------|----------|-------|
| **Development Setup** | Install fluxaos itself | 5-10 min | [Guide](development-setup.md) |
| **New Project** | Add fluxaos to any project | 2 min | [Guide](project-integration.md) |

## Quick Start

### 1. Install fluxaos (One-Time)

```bash
git clone ssh://git@git.jdp21.com:222/jpierce/fluxaos.git /path/to/fluxaos
cd /path/to/fluxaos
./flu install
```

See [Development Setup Guide](development-setup.md) for details.

### 2. Add to Your Projects

```bash
flu project setup /mnt/dev/your-project
```

This interactive command:
- Asks for CLI name, description, project type
- Creates project-specific install scripts
- Sets up Poetry with fluxaos dependency
- Syncs `.claude/` documentation
- Creates global symlink

See [Project Integration Guide](project-integration.md) for details.

### 3. Keep Projects Synchronized

```bash
fhc sync
```

See [Sync Workflows Guide](../sync-workflows.md) for details.

---

## What You Get

After installation:

- **Unified CLI** - Same git/PR/issue commands across all projects
- **Correct branding** - Each project shows its own name
- **Claude integration** - Slash commands for AI-assisted development
- **Automatic sync** - Keep documentation updated with `fhc sync`

---

## Prerequisites

- **Python 3.9+**
- **Poetry** ([Installation Guide](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation))
- **Git**
